Help:
Available chat commands:
<color=red>/PH_PLUGIN_CMD status</color> shows plugin infos
<color=red>/PH_PLUGIN_CMD open</color> opens the plugin menu

<color=yellow>Tip:</color> Bind the command <color=red>/PH_PLUGIN_CMD open</color> to a mouse button or keyboard key.
